# Apple Dental

> Apple Dental is a family-friendly dental clinic in Lane Cove, Sydney offering comprehensive general, cosmetic, and specialist dental services with experienced dentists and advanced technology like CEREC and Invisalign.

Located in Lane Cove with a team of experienced dentists including Dr Ivan Crnkovic, Dr Mandy Zheng, and Dr Hiba Amin, Apple Dental provides preventative, restorative, and cosmetic dental care. The clinic serves the greater Sydney area including Chatswood and North Sydney, with flexible payment plans and new patient offers available.

- [Root Canal Treatment Lane Cove - Dentist Lane Cove - Apple Dental](https://www.appledental.com.au/endodontics): Root canal treatment for infected tooth pulp and pain relief with tooth preservation
- [Dental Crowns Lane Cove - Apple Dental](https://www.appledental.com.au/dental-crowns): Dental crown restoration using CEREC technology for damaged teeth repair in one visit
- [Tooth Fillings Lane Cove - Teeth Restoration - Apple Dental](https://www.appledental.com.au/dental-fillings): Tooth-colored composite fillings and amalgam replacement using CEREC ceramic technology
- [Periodontal Disease Treatment - Dentist Lane Cove - Apple Dental](https://www.appledental.com.au/periodontics): Gum disease treatment including scaling, root planing, and periodontal disease management
- [Precision Meets Care with Tooth Extractions - Apple Dental](https://www.appledental.com.au/tooth-extractions): Gentle tooth extraction and wisdom teeth removal with bone grafting and implant options
